mapper.sql: id, content, question_type AS questionType, is_fixed AS isFixed, explanation, status, sort, creator_id AS creatorId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_question (content, question_type, is_fixed, explanation, status, sort, creator_id) VALUES (#{content}, #{questionType}, #{isFixed}, #{explanation}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{creatorId})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_question WHERE is_fixed = 1 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT
FROM sys_question WHERE is_fixed = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_question WHERE is_fixed = 1 AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_question WHERE is_fixed = 0 AND status = 1
